# Winifred Tolley

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c15 P32](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0032)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls  <sub>[v4 c11 P4](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0004)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c10 P22](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0022)</sub>; Mrs. Ambrose Kerr  <sub>[v5 c17 P76](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

She has gentle brown eyes.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P17](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0017)_

## Personality

Miss Winifred is a sharp-tongued yet deeply compassionate woman, described as having the most venomous tongue and the most compassionate heart in Seven Gulls. She harbors an intense dislike of men and Methodists, frequently expressing cynical views about male shortcomings while maintaining strong solidarity among women. Despite her caustic opinions and self-satisfied manner, she turns up gently to help whenever anyone faces trouble. She is active in church affairs, proud of female capability, and highly opinionated about local gossip.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c15 P32](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0032), [v4 c15 P37](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0037), [v4 c22 P21](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0021)_

- Support and protect other women  <sub>[v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c22 P21](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0021)</sub>

## History

Miss Winifred Tolley resides in a bright emerald house about half a mile along the road in Seven Gulls. She is a dedicated Presbyterian who once led a women's committee to raise funds and build the church at Glen St. Agnes within six months after male church members stalled the effort. She maintains a close relationship with Lorna Vane, serving as her closest companion and sharing her tragic family history with Nell Harcourt. When chosen as a delegate to the W.F.M.S. conference in Portmaris, she arranged for Mrs. Thomas Holt to accompany her for a vacation and convinced Lorna to accommodate Adrian Treleaven as a paying guest during her absence. She frequently visits Nell and Doctor Hugh Carrow, hosting them for elaborate teas and dropping by to share neighborhood gossip, including news of Edmund's fight with Dan Coyle and rumors regarding Mr. Ashdown.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P35](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0035), [v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c10 P33](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0033), [v4 c11 P13](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0013), [v4 c15 P32](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0032), [v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c22 P21](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0021), [v4 c22 P24](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0024), [v5 c17 P75](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0075), [v5 c17 P77](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0077)_

## Background by volume

- Her father was named Stephen  <sub>[v4 c15 P41](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0041)</sub>
- Her grandmother was an Episcopalian  <sub>[v5 c17 P80](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0080)</sub>
- Her cousin Flora lived up at the Glen  <sub>[v4 c11 P2](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0002)</sub>
- Had numerous suitors in her youth but declined them all  <sub>[v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040)</sub>

## Quotes

> Believe ME, I’m not eager for the right to vote. I understand the reality of tidying up the mess men leave behind.  <sub>[v4 c15 P37](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0037)</sub>

> I did not state that the Methodists lacked common sense, Captain. My point is, I question whether they possess a great deal of religion.  <sub>[v4 c15 P35](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0035)</sub>

> Now, Nell, as you are aware, my position is consistently that we female folk should support one another. Heaven knows we are subjected to a sufficient amount of hardship from men, which is why I maintain that we should refrain from attacking each other, and rarely will you catch me disparaging a fellow woman.  <sub>[v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)</sub>
